messages.body:
Hii all
I am trying to install Ambertool16 in my ubuntu 20.04 linux system.
During make install step, I am getting the following error
/usr/include/c++/9/ostream:691:5: error: no type named ‘type’ in
‘struct std::enable_if<false, std::basic_ostream<char>&>’
g++ -c -O3  -DAROMATICS_ACCEPT_HBONDS -DCHARFUNCMACROS
-DBOOLPREDEFINED  -DBRACKETOPERPARMS -DLEFT_JUSTIFY_NUC_RES_OK
-DLISTFRIENDFIX -DINCTEMPLATEDEFNS
-DHET_DICTIONARY='"/home/pcs/softwares/amber16/dat/reduce_wwPDB_het_dict.txt"'
-I../libpdb -I../toolclasses   -o DotSph.o DotSph.cpp
g++ -c -O3  -DAROMATICS_ACCEPT_HBONDS -DCHARFUNCMACROS
-DBOOLPREDEFINED  -DBRACKETOPERPARMS -DLEFT_JUSTIFY_NUC_RES_OK
-DLISTFRIENDFIX -DINCTEMPLATEDEFNS
-DHET_DICTIONARY='"/home/pcs/softwares/amber16/dat/reduce_wwPDB_het_dict.txt"'
-I../libpdb -I../toolclasses   -o Mover.o Mover.cpp
make[3]: *** [Makefile:33: GraphToHoldScores.o] Error 1
make[3]: *** Waiting for unfinished jobs....
make[3]: Leaving directory
'/home/pcs/softwares/amber16/AmberTools/src/reduce/reduce_src'
make[2]: *** [Makefile:19: install] Error 2
make[2]: Leaving directory
'/home/pcs/softwares/amber16/AmberTools/src/reduce'
make[1]: *** [Makefile:28: serial] Error 2
make[1]: Leaving directory '/home/pcs/softwares/amber16/AmberTools/src'
make: *** [Makefile:7: install] Error 2
Can anyone help me to solve this out??
Thank you
Sunipa Sarkar

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
You don’t say what compilers/version you’re using, but if they are recent
they probably haven’t been tested with AT16 (which is over 5 years old
now). You might want to try using an earlier compiler.
-Dan

On Fri, Feb 25, 2022, spss4.iacs.res.in wrote:
>I have tried in different machine. I am using the proxy address where
>�
https://www.anaconda.com
is not blocked. Still I am getting the
>following error
>�
> CondaHTTPError: HTTP 000 CONNECTION FAILED for url
><
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main/linux-64/current_repodata.json
>
> Elapsed: -
If you can't connect to the anaconda websites, you will probably need to
skip downloading miniconda.  Try adding this to your run_cmake script:
-DBUILD_PYTHON=FALSE  -DDOWNLOAD_MINICONDA=FALSE
That should get you going, then you can try again with a python installation
that is already on your machine.  (This assumes you need the python
programs: many people don't.)
....dac
